title: Opening a company account
purpose: Who qualifies for an account and the steps to open one.
facts: Threshold: five vehicles and six months as a paying customer.
Credit application names an approver and a payer.
Slot 2 approves and sets the credit limit.
Terms: 15 days under ten vehicles, 30 days from ten (matches A3 with 9 and A4 with 8 at 15 days; A5 with 11, A6 with 10, A1 and A2 at 30).
Slot 4 writes the account page and the terms-table row; slot 3 sets terms in the shop system (ERP customer: payment terms and credit limit).
The company rate is by agreement with slot 2 only.

list_items.item: Five vehicles or more, and at least six months as a customer paying at the counter.
The business fills in the credit application (Donna has the form) and names one person who approves work and one who pays bills. They may be the same person.
I approve it and set the credit limit. Nobody else opens an account.
Terms: 15 days for a fleet of fewer than ten vehicles, 30 days from ten up.
Greg writes the account's page in this folder and adds the row to the terms table: approver, anything the shop needs to know. No page, no account.
Donna sets the customer up in the shop system with its terms. From that day its vehicles are not charged at the counter.

new_facts: The fleet-size rule for terms (15 days under ten vehicles, 30 from ten). Reason: explains the two payment terms in accounts.json with one rule.
Six months as a counter customer before an account.
